ARTICLE IN PRESS

Midwifery xxx (xxxx) xxx–xxx

Elsevier logo with a black-and-white tree emblem above the orange word “ELSEVIER.”

Contents lists available at ScienceDirect

Cover of the journal Midwifery, with the title in white on a blue banner above a circular blue-and-pink abstract illustration.

Midwifery

journal homepage: www.elsevier.com/locate/midw

Corrigendum

Corrigendum to “Midwifery continuity of carer in an area of high socio-
economic disadvantage in London: A retrospective analysis of Albany
Midwifery Practice outcomes using routine data (1997–2009)” [Midwifery
48 (2017) 1–10]

Caroline S.E. Homer, RM, MMed(ClinEpi), PhD Professor a,* , Nicky Leap, DMid Adjunct
Professor of Midwifery a , Nadine Edwards, PhD Independent Researcher a,b,c , Jane Sandall, PhD,
CBE Professor, NIHR Senior Investigator b,c

a   Centre for Midwifery, Child and Family Health, Faculty of Health, University of Technology Sydney, PO Box 123, Broadway, Sydney, New South Wales
2007, Australia

b   Division of Women's Health, Faculty of Life Sciences & Medicine, King's College London, United Kingdom

c   Women's Health Academic Centre, St. Thomas' Hospital, London SE1 7EH, United Kingdom

The authors regret that on page 8 we inadvertently referred to NICE as providing policy and policy direction. This was incorrect. NICE provides
national clinical  guidance  based on systematic reviews. The sentence should read: A large study comparing perinatal outcomes by planned place of
birth (Birthplace in England Collaborative Group, 2011) supported the clinical guidance to offer women with low risk pregnancies a choice of birth
settings, including birth at home (NICE, 2014).

The authors would like to apologise for any inconvenience caused.

DOI of original article: http://dx.doi.org/10.1016/j.midw.2017.02.009
Corresponding author.
E-mail address:  caroline.homer@uts.edu.au (C.S.E. Homer).

http://dx.doi.org/10.1016/j.midw.2017.05.013
